Released on 2026-11-12.
This minor update adds VM resource overrides, recoverable root-disk growth,
configurable Linux lifecycle concurrency, and inventory-based host names.
It also refreshes the build toolchain.

## Upgrade from 1.1.0

Omitted Linux CPU/memory values now resolve to 1 vCPU / 2 GiB instead of
2 vCPUs / 4 GiB. Existing inventories that omit these fields use the new
defaults when read by 1.2.0. To retain the earlier defaults, add
`vm_cpu: 2` and `vm_mem: 4GiB` under `all.vars`, preserving any per-host
overrides, and inspect `barn plan` before applying changes. Existing applied
VMs retain their resources until a resource-changing operation is requested.
Root and data-disk defaults remain 64 GiB and 128 GiB respectively.

## VM resources and concurrency

- Use `--cpu/-C`, `--mem/-M`, `--scale/-S`, and `--disk/-D` for resource
  overrides, alongside the image and architecture selectors. The corresponding
  `BARN_*` environment variables provide defaults; command-line values take
  precedence. Generated inventories save the base settings.
- Grow an existing root disk with `resize --disk/-D`. Barn stops QEMU before
  enlarging the disk, verifies the guest partition and ext4/XFS filesystem,
  and records progress so an interrupted resize can resume. Shrinking and
  unsupported root layouts are rejected.
- Read effective resources in `SPEC` labels such as `2c4g`; structured output
  includes numeric resources, their bases, multiplier, and input sources.
- Set Linux lifecycle concurrency with `--parallel/-p`. The default is the
  logical CPU count minus two, with a minimum of one. Zero runs all selected
  nodes concurrently; a positive value sets the maximum.

## Inventory host names

Declare extra service names in `all.vars.vm_hosts`, then preview the combined
node and service mappings with `barn hosts install -f pigsty.yml --json`.
Apply the reviewed plan with `barn hosts install -f pigsty.yml --yes`.
The inventory path works before VM creation; omitting `-f` continues to use
applied node names. Duplicate mappings merge case-insensitively, conflicting
addresses fail, and these host-side mappings leave VM identity and guest
configuration unchanged.

## Dependencies and packaging

Source builds, CI, and release artifacts require Go 1.27.4. The module refresh
updates `golang.org/x/sys` to 0.50.0, `golang.org/x/term` to 0.48.0,
`golang.org/x/text` to 0.44.0, and `github.com/klauspost/compress` to 1.20.4.
All other requirements listed in `go.mod` already use their latest stable
versions as checked on 2026-11-11.

Packaging uses GoReleaser 2.20.1 with bundled nFPM 2.48.0, and Syft 1.57.1.
Download checksums and dependency licenses match those versions. Existing
quality-tool versions and GitHub Actions commit pins are current.
RPM payload verification now requires `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` timestamps,
matching nFPM 2.48's archive output.

The signed image catalog remains revision `2026110502`, with 17 stable
architecture-specific artifacts. Both official repositories match the embedded
catalog; the default is Ubuntu 24.04 on the host's native architecture.

## Upgrade and downloads

Stop running macOS guests before replacing `Barn.app`, then upgrade:

```bash
brew update
brew upgrade pgsty/infra/barn
```

Or use the versioned installer:

```bash
curl -fLO https://github.com/pgsty/barn/releases/download/v1.2.0/install.sh
BARN_VERSION=1.2.0 bash install.sh
barn version
```

The installer verifies the archive against `checksums.txt`. The Darwin arm64
archive includes the Developer ID signed and notarized CLI, hosts helper,
and `Barn.app`; other archives and Linux DEB/RPM packages include the CLI
and matching helper. VM disks, keys, and state remain under `BARN_HOME`.

See the [command reference](https://barn.pgsty.com/docs/reference/commands/),
[full changelog](https://github.com/pgsty/barn/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.md), and
[changes since 1.1.0](https://github.com/pgsty/barn/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0).
